# runzero_asset (Resource)

Manages a RunZero asset. Assets are discovered via scans and adopted into Terraform by ID. Supports updating comments and criticality.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the asset.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments for the asset.
- `criticality` (String) The criticality level of the asset (e.g. low, medium, high, critical).

### Read-Only

- `alive` (Boolean) Whether the asset is alive.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was created.
- `first_seen` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was first seen.
- `hw` (String) The hardware description of the asset.
- `last_seen` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was last seen.
- `os` (String) The operating system of the asset.
- `os_version` (String) The OS version of the asset.
- `risk` (String) The risk level of the asset.
- `risk_rank` (Number) The numeric risk rank (-1=none, 0=info, 4=critical).
- `site_id` (String) The site ID the asset belongs to.
- `type` (String) The type of the asset (e.g. Server, Workstation).
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was last updated.
